text: Items 1-4 landed with tests: (1) learned-metric admission fixed — metric_status now derived from the metric's learned_frozen capability, provenance preserved through support restriction, refusal fires on capability not class; (2) typed generalizes_over axis on pairing()/cross_partitions(), bound into task and metric-pairing identity — cross-run vs cross-session now distinct under generic labels, undeclared axis keeps legacy ids; (3) route-stable scientific_plan_id — view identity = parent estimand id + view semantics on both fused and projected routes, new estimand_id field in execution plans with base-task-id and parent-signature binding checks, projection receipts mark +projected_view; (4) classed effect_capability_refusal conditions with all-reasons reporting and remedies, exported catch_refusal(), sentences for all 11 sampling reasons. New test files: test-capability-refusals.R, test-generalization-axis.R, test-route-identity.R. Remaining: gallery stubs (5), honest tests (6), conservation (7), silent fallbacks (8).
